purpose: Base geometry for course-specific wide-trip interpretation. Combine with course_first_turn_distance_v1 and empirical diagnostics; do not use alone as a betting score.
source: JRA official racecourse/course and track overview pages; A-course dimensions where multiple rail settings exist.

usage_rules: Do not convert venue size directly into a single wide-trip score.
Use first-turn distance separately to estimate opportunity to settle inward before the first material turn.
Use route-specific loop/straight geometry to describe how much of the race is corner-dominant versus straight-dominant.
Actual lateral path is unavailable in TARGET result CSV, so empirical gate effects are proxies rather than measured meters lost.
Final horse-level interpretation should combine geometry, gate, predicted queue/position, acceleration and sustained ability without changing Production ticket logic.
